rows.name: jQuery formBuilder with formRender
rows.reason: MIT jQuery formBuilder/formRender provides drag/drop and JSON/XML definitions, not hosted service. Application supplies storage/submissions, server validation and email/PDF. Requires jQuery; implementation-source retrieval failed, source-tree docs available.

rows.name: MachForm Self-Hosted
rows.reason: MachForm is a commercial self-hosted PHP/MySQL visual builder with email, PDF attachments and webhooks. Current $99 one-time pricing is not verified for February 2025; tier/access/integration need checking.

rows.name: Microsoft Power Apps canvas app form (external guest access)
rows.reason: Unresolved: Entra guest authentication/licensing required; universal new-account requirement unestablished. B2B permits existing identities/email passcodes. Verify canvas redemption, authoring/data integration and cost; exclude forced respondent account creation.

rows.name: Reef Form Generator
rows.reason: Reef embeds PHP/JavaScript form editing, validation and PDO storage. LGPL 3.0; application must supply access control and email/PDF integration. Runtime compatibility unverified; complex custom forms exceed its emphasis.

rows.name: Form Tools with Form Builder
rows.reason: Free PHP/MySQL forms store submissions and allow client editing. Documented form creation requires administrator access; ordinary client-data accounts cannot be assumed to design forms. Host/runtime compatibility and integration untested.

rows.name: SurveyJS Survey Creator with Form Library
rows.reason: SurveyJS embeds JSON-form editing and PHP submissions. Renderer is free; Creator costs $559/developer, with optional update/support renewal. PDF requires higher tier; backend/email integration remains required.

rows.name: OpnForm
rows.reason: OpnForm's self-hostable visual builder, email and webhooks could collect forms and forward answers. Verify self-hosted licensing and respondent access; operating the full application adds deployment work.

rows.name: FORM symbolic manipulation system
rows.reason: FORM manipulates large algebraic expressions, outside staff-designed booking/customer-input forms. This is a documented operating-surface mismatch, not an assumption that every unmentioned feature is unsupported.

rows.name: Microsoft Power Apps canvas app form (external guest access)
rows.reason: Requires Microsoft Entra guest authentication and suitable user licensing, conflicting with public booking forms that customers can complete without first arranging account access.

rows.name: Form Tools
rows.reason: Its PHP/MySQL interface lets staff build and publish forms and store submissions locally, matching client-managed form design and server-side data collection.

rows.name: Form Tools with the Form Builder module
rows.reason: Form Tools/Form Builder offers PHP/MySQL forms and server-held submissions. Core is free/open-source; module licensing and PHP support remain unestablished. Database mapping, PDF and email may require integration.

rows.name: Form Tools
rows.reason: Form Tools documents free PHP/MySQL visual form building, client-site publication and server submissions. Staff can use administrator editing; existing application supplies database/PDF/email integration. No decisive stated-condition violation.

rows.name: jQuery formBuilder with formRender
rows.reason: MIT jQuery formBuilder/formRender embeds client-side design, rendering and PHP-facing APIs. Replace session-storage onSave with server requests; server validation, permissions and durable storage remain application work.

rows.name: FORM symbolic manipulation system
rows.reason: It manipulates mathematical expressions for scientific computation; it does not provide a web form editor, customer submission workflow, or email delivery.

rows.name: OpnForm
rows.reason: OpnForm offers no-code forms, email and webhooks. Hosted respondent signup/account/integration requirements remain unconfirmed. Free self-hosting permits two instance users; additional users/some advanced features require Enterprise pricing not retrieved.

rows.name: SurveyJS Survey Creator with Form Library
rows.reason: SurveyJS supports visual forms and PHP submissions. Creator is paid; renderer is free. Current Basic costs US$559/developer once; 2025 pricing and affordability remain unknown. Backend endpoints require development.
